meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Every Vink plan includes everything: unlimited users, all Forms and Fields, review and webhooks. Choose how many pages. From €49 a month, 20 free pages to start.

og.title: Every plan includes everything. You only choose how many pages.
og.alt: Vink pricing. Every plan includes everything. You only choose how many pages.

header.title: Every plan includes everything. You only choose how many pages.
header.subtitle: Prices in EUR, excl. VAT. + VAT where applicable.

plans.starter: For a team that handles a few papers a day.
plans.team: For a team that processes new mail every hour.
plans.business: For departments with a steady stream of paperwork.

free: Start with 20 free pages. No credit card.

custom.name: Custom
custom.title: Need more than 3,000 pages a month?
custom.body: From {price} a month, billed annually. A volume price, custom terms and a service level agreed with you.

users.title: Unlimited users
users.body: Invite the whole team. No seat count.

forms.title: All Forms and Fields
forms.body: As many Forms as you need, with your own Fields and Lists.

review.title: Review and Approval
review.body: Check what's unsure, approve, or let Auto-Send handle the sure ones.

integrations.title: Integrations (webhook)
integrations.body: Signed JSON to your system, with retries and a test-send.

users.a: No. Every plan has unlimited users. You pay for pages, not seats.

page.a: One page of a PDF. A Submission counts its pages once, when Vink accepts it for reading. Retries after a failed read are free. Moving a Submission to another Form is free too.

runOut.q: What happens when our pages run out?
runOut.a: A new PDF that doesn't fit your remaining pages is refused at upload, with a clear message. Everything already uploaded keeps working. You can upgrade, or add a top-up of €10 per 100 pages that lasts until the end of the current month.

rollover.a: No. Your pages renew every month, also on annual billing, and unused pages expire.

vat.q: Are prices with or without VAT?
vat.a: All prices are in EUR, excl. VAT. VAT is added where applicable.

cancel.a: Yes, you can cancel at any time. Your plan then runs until the end of the current month or year. After that, you pay nothing more. The 20 free pages need no card and have no end date.

intake.q: How does your paperwork get in?
intake.a: Upload several PDFs and photos at once in the app, or email them to a Form's own address. Vink turns each email into one or more Submissions. PDFs of up to 10 MB and 20 pages. Other sources? <link>Tell us</link>.

jsonld.description: Vink reads PDFs, typed, scanned or handwritten, and turns them into clean JSON for your systems. People only check the values Vink isn't sure about.
jsonld.offer: {count} pages a month, billed monthly, excl. VAT
